name: Command & Control
summary: Amarok — the pack's remediation executor. Drives navi action push (remote code execution over SSH to ONE Linux host) to run a command, ship a file, or apply a patch derived from the vulns table. The single highest-risk capability in the pack: TRIPLE-gated (writes + NAVI_REMOTE_CODE_EXECUTION + per-host confirm), Linux-only, destructive-command denylist, armed campaigns that go canary-first with stop-on-failure and an abort switch, and Route→Tag→Push→Verify to prove the finding actually closed. Every push is written to the Tagging ledger (op=push).
